title: Les bases de la danse classique┃ELLE Danse

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces the basic positions and movements of classical ballet. She breaks down each step into small, manageable chunks, demonstrating them slowly before combining them into a short, fluid sequence. She emphasizes proper technique and body alignment throughout the lesson.
method.signature: The teacher uses the term 'dégagé' to describe the gliding movement of the foot, which is a key concept in ballet technique.

practices.what: The teacher explains and demonstrates the first position of the feet and arms.
The teacher breaks down the 'dégagé' movement with the right leg.
The teacher introduces the 'temps lié' movement.
The teacher demonstrates a movement involving a 'dégagé' with the left leg followed by a fall.
The teacher explains the 'coupé pas de bourré' movement.
The teacher performs the entire sequence of movements learned so far.

adaptations.adjustment: Do not force the alignment; focus on finding balance in the first position.

beliefs.belief: The teacher believes that anyone can learn the basics of classical dance, regardless of their current level.

feelings.response: The teacher acknowledges the learner's apprehension about the legs and reassures them.
The teacher encourages the learner to stay calm and confident while balancing.
The teacher notices the learner's confusion and tells them not to worry, then offers to re-explain.
The teacher reassures the learner that the movement is simple and will be explained clearly.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the learner, introduces the lesson as a beginner's classical dance class, and promises to take time to explain every detail.
The teacher acknowledges that the next part is the one the learner might find most difficult, which is the legs.
The teacher points out a common mistake of moving the knee and explains that it should remain open and stable.
The teacher encourages the learner to have confidence and stay calm while balancing.
The teacher notices the learner might be confused and offers to re-explain the step.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and supported, emphasizing that they can master the steps with patience and practice.

clicked.theme: Clear explanations and well-adapted for beginners
Progress is visible after repeating the lesson

method.limits: The video does not show the teacher's full body in all angles, which might make it difficult for learners to see the exact placement of the feet and arms.
